passages.text: Eriobotrya deflexa, the bronze loquat, is a tree native to China (Guangdong, Hainan), Taiwan and Vietnam.
Its leaves are used in Taiwanese folk medicine as an expectorant.

Hybrids
× Rhaphiobotrya is an artificial hybrid genus between species of Eriobotrya and Rhaphiolepis. Hybrids include the coppertone loquat (× Rhaphiobotrya 'Coppertone'), the parents of which are Eriobotrya deflexa and Rhaphiolepis indica or R. × delacourii. It is a popular cultivated shrub in the Southern United States and California.{{citation needed|date=June 2024}}
